summary: On Christmas Day, a hiker identified as Cole was found severely hypothermic on the summit of Quandary Peak after stripping layers in sub-zero wind. Fellow hikers Jason (on skis) and Mike redressed him, pressed their SPOT satellite-messenger SOS buttons, and helped him down the East Ridge; a passing climber carried Cole's pack and steadied him. Rescue personnel met the group below treeline and evacuated Cole by snowmobile to an ambulance at the trailhead; he had frostbitten hands and facial frostbite.
notes: Date from author's Christmas Day narrative; rescue photo uploaded 2015/12 indicating Dec 2015. Responding agency not named in source; Jason and Mike's SPOT SOS alerts summoned help.
